phrase: I didn't know it was me
quote: I was looking down at the me in the bed and I didn't know it was me. And I thought, wow, I hope she's okay.

phrase: I didn't even realize at first that it was me
quote: When I was leaving my body I saw this body, this thing — I didn't even realize at first that it was me.

phrase: that's me, but it wasn't me
quote: That's me. But it wasn't me. There was my body, that skin suit that I had been wearing around life.

phrase: I didn't think for a second that that was me
quote: It almost didn't look human. I didn't think for a second that that was me, because me was up here watching.
